- The product is described as “horrible,” “awful,” and overall disappointing, leading reviewers to say they will never buy Pantene again[1][2].

- Another 1‑star reviewer says the new formula “does **not** work,” leaving hair “dull and super staticky and extremely flyaway,” with “no volume, no shine, no manageability”[5].  
- The same reviewer calls the change a “huge disappointment” and criticizes Pantene for discontinuing a line they preferred[5].  
- Review 6 contains a vague comment about “Pantene is my favorite not from this supplier way to much money,” which may hint at a price‑related complaint, though the statement is unclear.
